catalog.editionAsPrinted: 5-91-RP-500-212 (page footers "Printed in U.S.A. April 1991"; page headers "39" Lawn Tractor Model 1112H")
catalog.structure: PDF p1 cover + alphabetical index, p2 general information, p3-21 diagram/table spreads (printed pages 5-41: tractor pp5-31 with Murray-style key#/part#/qty listings, hydrostatic pump p31 and engine pp33-41 with typewriter-style KEY/PART NO./QTY tables), p22-23 numerical index (printed pp42-45)

engines.appliesNote: all serials; printed "12 HP B&S I/C" (B&S model and type are not printed anywhere in the book)

editions.serialAsPrinted: No serial range, ID table or serial break printed anywhere in the book (all serials).

attachments.note: Side discharge (user, 2026-11-16). The book lists the 39" SD deck (pre-painted deck p19, final deck p21). TractorData also lists a 39" mid-mount mower deck for the 1112.
TractorData lists a blade for the 1112 with no size or model given (https://www.tractordata.com/lawn-tractors/000/7/5/755-ingersoll-1112.html); applied here as for the 1112.

relations.note: Gear-drive sibling (catalog 8-3160): same engine C34536, same Murray-style tractor listings and 39" SD deck; the 1112H differs in the hydrostatic transaxle, pump, belts and motion-drive parts. Serial cannot tell them apart; ask the customer for gear or hydrostatic.

validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from native 200-dpi crops of the table half of each spread plus zooms on doubtful cells; tesseract used only as a cross-check (the scan is speckled and it misreads quantities). Each section was diffed against 8-3160 row by row to catch shared pages (tractor chassis, steering, decks, electrical and engine pages are largely shared; motion drive, transaxle and pump differ). Numerical index (printed pp42-45) read by OCR per column, then compared line by line against an expected index rendered from the transcription, both directions, with every mismatch checked by eye on the image.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except printed gaps: chassis_hood refs 54-63 (table jumps 53 to 64), motion_drive refs 66-69 (65 to 70), transaxle refs 11, 50 and 62, flywheel_stator refs 2 and 6, carburetor refs 26, 27 and 43. Repeated refs kept as printed: engine_block 9, 18, 19 and 21 (size/thickness options), transaxle 28 and 49 (washer options), ref 0 on transaxle, hydrostatic_pump (two kits), engine_block (gasket set) and carburetor (three different parts). Electrical refs 35A/35B. Two rows have no part number (decals refs 3 and 14, 'REFERENCE ONLY', qty 1).
validation.quantities: All rows carry a qty except: the 17 hydrostatic_pump rows (that table has no qty column) and motion_drive 104 (tire, no qty). UAR (use as required) on transaxle 28 (two rows) and 49. Inch quantities kept as printed (chassis trim strip 77.5", gas line 13"). Qty column is in register on every page.
validation.numericalIndex: All 691 (part, page, ref) entries expected from the transcription were compared with the printed index (11 columns, pp42-45), both directions; the index has exactly 691 lines and all match except three differences: the index prints C25421 at 13/27 where the table prints C35421 (motion_drive ref 27; no C35421 line exists in the index, table value kept, confirmed by user 2026-11-16); and hardware codes 11-312 and 41-24 appear in the index as 011- 312 and 041- 24 (zero-padded). Seven ref-0 parts (C34534, C35405, C35546, C30422, C27255, C30424, C31978) are listed in the index with no ref number. The 27 NSS rows and the 2 decal reference-only rows have no part number and are not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs 'BR' numbers stored bare (391406), Case letter prefixes stored as printed closed up (C35064, C34536), hardware codes 'NNN-NNNN' as printed (187-1508). This book prints no spaces after the prefix or hyphen, so partNoAsPrinted equals the stored form except for BR prefixes. '*' and '**' part-number cells stored as NSS with the footnote; footnote marks on C34534**, C35405*, C34536*, **C35036 and **C35351 are removed from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted.
